name: Raised Buckwheat Cakes
description: Historical recipe from The Whitehouse Cookbook (1887). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: one quart of warm water or half water and milk
ingredients.originalText: one quart of warm water or half water and milk
ingredients.quantityText: one quart of warm water or half water and milk

ingredients.name: small level teaspoonful of soda
ingredients.originalText: one small level teaspoonful of soda

instructions.text: Put into a crock or large earthen pitcher one quart of warm water or half water and milk, and one heaping teaspoonful of salt
Stir in as much buckwheat flour as will thicken it to rather a stiff batter
Add half a cup of yeast
Make it smooth, cover it up warm to rise over night
In the morning add a small, level teaspoonful of soda dissolved in a little warm water

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Put into a crock or large earthen pitcher one quart of warm water or half water and milk, and one heaping teaspoonful of salt
2. Stir in as much buckwheat flour as will thicken it to rather a stiff batter
3. Add half a cup of yeast
4. Make it smooth, cover it up warm to rise over night
5. In the morning add a small, level teaspoonful of soda dissolved in a little warm water
